leadText:
(Japanese: ジャンプ Jump) is a character of the day who appeared in Saved by the Beldum. He is a Pokémon Trainer who competed in the preliminary rounds of the Ever Grande Conference. He was not given an official name in the English dub.

During the Hoenn League , Jump faced off against Morrison. He had an advantage since Morrison's Beldum only knew and he was constantly commanding his Electabuzz to use to negate all damage.

Just when it looked like Jump was going to be the victor, Morrison's evolved into a and defeated Electabuzz using a combination of and Take Down. Jump's loss meant that he was out of the tournament.
